rv.q: This production is as heartfelt and lively as one would hope, reminding audiences why The Sound of Music continues to be a beloved classic.

cn.t: The beloved classic continues to charm audiences on tour with its timeless story and familiar songs, proving its enduring appeal more than 65 years after its Broadway debut.
